requirements.desc: When pass history from a previous gate evaluation exists in the issue-log, the guardrail evaluation prompt shall include a 'Previously Passed Guardrails' section containing the list of previously-passed guardrail IDs.
requirements.note: Implemented in `buildGuardrailPromptFromFiltered` by conditionally appending a `Previously Passed Guardrails` section with joined guardrail IDs when `previouslyPassedIds` is non-empty.

requirements.desc: When pass history is available, the prompt builder shall accept and incorporate the list of previously-passed guardrail IDs for all retry-tracked phases (draft, spec, task-impl, integration).
requirements.note: Prompt-builder path now accepts `previouslyPassedIds` (`buildGuardrailPrompt` -> `buildGuardrailPromptFromFiltered`), and `runGateFlow` retrieves prior pass history via `findPreviousPassedGuardrails` for `RETRY_TRACKED_PHASES` and passes it into `checkGuardrail`.

requirements.desc: When no pass history exists (first evaluation or no issue-log entries), the prompt shall remain unchanged from the current behavior.
requirements.note: Prompt injection is guarded by `Array.isArray(previouslyPassedIds) && previouslyPassedIds.length > 0`; tests verify no section for `undefined`/empty and exact prompt equality vs prior behavior.

requirements.desc: When the same content is re-evaluated with identical working-tree state, the existing mechanical flip override shall be retained alongside the prompt-based pass history as a fallback safety net.
requirements.note: No removal or alteration of flip-override behavior is present; pass-history prompt injection was added without replacing existing mechanical override logic.

unplanned.change: Removed unused `_config` parameter from `checkGuardrail` and updated call sites; this interface cleanup is not explicitly required by REQ-1..REQ-4.
Added extensive workflow/spec artifacts (draft, flow, issue-log, review, task docs, QA, test README) beyond the runtime behavior required by REQ-1..REQ-4.

summary.notes: All four listed requirements are satisfied by the code changes. Core behavior matches spec: pass history is injected into prompts when available, omitted when absent, and existing flip-override fallback remains in place.
